page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.hfg6 server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, but does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge offers a high-density compute profile with dedicated CPU resources, making it suitable for enterprise-grade workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core environments. Recommended workloads include general-purpose web serving, application servers, medium-sized databases, and CI/CD pipelines that benefit from a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-frequency Intel Xeon processors.
